---
title: "Research highlights"
description: >
  Key findings from the GEMMA project, written for a broad audience.
  Each highlight is available to download as a PDF policy brief.
listing:
  contents:
    - "*.qmd"
    - "!index.qmd"
  type: grid
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: true
  date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
  fields: [image, date, title, description, categories]
  feed: false
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

<!-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  RESEARCH HIGHLIGHT TEMPLATE — for authors adding new highlights
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Each highlight is a .qmd file in this folder. It renders as both a web page and
  a one-page PDF policy brief (branding + compaction in typst-template.typ and
  _metadata.yml). To keep the PDF on a single A4 page, keep body text to roughly
  550 words plus one figure.

  Standard section order (see any existing highlight for a worked example):

    1. Key points        — ::: {.key-points} with a `**Key points**` label and
                            3–4 bullets. The takeaways for a reader who reads
                            nothing else.
    2. Why this matters   — the policy problem BEFORE the work. Context only:
                            no results, no limitations.
    3. What GEMMA did     — one short paragraph of method. Infrastructure
                            highlights may use "What was installed" instead.
    4. What we found      — the findings, with the figure. (Infrastructure
                            highlights fold this into "What was installed".)
    5. What this means for policy — what is different now the work is done.
    6. What comes next    — planned follow-on work.

  Frontmatter conventions:
    - date: YYYY-MM-DD (displayed as "D MMMM YYYY" site-wide)
    - image: the figure used on listing cards
    - categories: use the controlled vocabulary only —
        gas:   methane · carbon dioxide · nitrous oxide · halocarbons · hydrogen
        theme: measurement network · inverse modelling · emissions by sector
    - Wrap the .pdf-download-bar and .highlight-meta blocks in
      ::: {.content-visible when-format="html"} so they stay out of the PDF.
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
